newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: MOTOCROSS-TORTELLI FORFEITS WINS BUT KEEPS CHAMPIONSHIP TITLE.
newsitem.headline: MOTOCROSS-TORTELLI FORFEITS WINS BUT KEEPS CHAMPIONSHIP TITLE.

text.p: World motocross 125cc champion Sebastien Tortelli retained his 1996 title on Friday despite being stripped of both his wins in the Belgian round of the championship for using illegal fuel.
The decision by the International Motorcycle Federation took 40 points off the Frenchman's final championship total but he still remained comfortably clear in the standings with 392 points.
Paul Malin of Britain, who finished second in the championship and was second behind Tortelli in both races at the July 7 meeting was also stripped of his points for the same offence.
It reduced Malin's final championship points total to 283 but he remained ahead of Frederic Vialle of France who finished the season third on 276.
